result.title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
result.comment: ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bianyh/ChartInt
result.summary: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. Additionally, ChartInt incorporates editing tasks such as data updates, style adjustments, and cross-chart style transfer to expand real-world application scenarios. To enable reliable evaluation of interaction behavior, we propose a preset state snapshot protocol that predefines target interaction states and deterministically triggers interaction events, transforming dynamic behaviors into reproducible evaluation targets. Based on this protocol, we design a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring semantic and stylistic consistency. Experiments show that while current MLLMs perform well on static charts, their performance drops significantly on interactive tasks, highlighting the need for interaction-aware benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ChartInt 基准，用于评测 MLLM 在交互式图表（hover、highlight、tooltip 及编辑任务）上的 chart-to-code 生成，并用预设状态快照协议把动态交互转为可复现的多维一致性评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究目标是图表到代码的生成与交互行为一致性评测，既不涉及内部视觉推理状态或 latent 表示，也无证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策方面的具体线索，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
